Management states customer investment deferred by US tariff policies recovered and data center-related demand remained strong, but this did not make up for the first-quarter decline, so revenue fell; profitability improved through continued inventory reduction and cost control

Management states that in network infrastructure, data center construction and capacity expansion are accelerating to handle the surge in data traffic from generative AI: the upgrade to 800GE networks is in full swing, optical transceiver makers are increasing 800GE transceiver production and developing next-generation 1.6TE transceivers, network equipment makers are developing high-speed buses such as PCIe Gen6, hyperscalers are laying optical submarine cables on new routes to connect data centers globally, and activity toward all-optical networks is increasing; demand for the related measurement solutions is expanding. It expects measurement demand for data center network speed-up to keep growing with the spread of generative AI

Management states 6G commercial service is targeted to start in 2030, with specifications under study at 3GPP as Release 20, and expects demand for 6G-capable measurement instruments to ramp up in earnest from around 2027; with development for the FR3 band (7 GHz to 15 GHz) and moves to offer 6G service at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, it projects 6G development demand to expand earlier than initially assumed. The company developed an RF module for the MT8000A test station supporting up to the 15 GHz band (FR3). Smartphone market described as stable, led by high-function AI smartphones; demand for aerospace & national security (ANS) instruments is increasing
quarterly_data.figure: 6G commercial service 2030; 6G instrument demand from around 2027; up to 15 GHz

quarterly_data.signal: Mid-term plan GLP2026 targets for its final year, the FY ending March 2027 (100 million yen): group revenue 1,400, operating profit 200, profit 150 and ROE 12%, the same as the company's outlook; Test & Measurement target revenue 900 and operating profit 150 versus the outlook of 850 and 165; PQA target 300 / 36 versus outlook 330 / 40; Environmental Measurement target 130 / 14 versus outlook 160 / 10. GLP2026 policies: growth investment of 400 (100 million yen) or more (M&A plus capex) and 25% of FY2026 (year ending March 2027) operating profit generated outside Test & Measurement; the group aims to be a revenue 2,000 (100 million yen) company in fiscal 2030
quarterly_data.figure: GLP2026 target revenue 1,400 / operating profit 200 (100 million yen); T&M target 900 / 150 vs outlook 850 / 165; 2030 revenue target 2,000 (100 million yen)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was JPY 5,766 million (up 71.0%; Test & Measurement JPY 3,135 million, 144.1% of the prior year) for new product development and cost reduction; R&D investment (including capitalized development costs) was JPY 10,179 million (up 3.0%; 8.7% of revenue), of which Test & Measurement JPY 7,740 million (11.3% of segment revenue). The company plans about JPY 11,000 million of capex (development environment and replacement of aging manufacturing equipment) and about JPY 11,000 million of R&D in the next fiscal year. Planned new facility: a PQA manufacturing building at the Atsugi head office, JPY 3,126 million total (JPY 669 million paid), started March 2026, completion March 2027
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 5,766 million (+71.0%); R&D JPY 10,179 million; next-year plan about JPY 11,000 million capex and about JPY 11,000 million R&D; Atsugi PQA building JPY 3,126 million

quarterly_data.signal: R&D result: new option MP2110A-080 for the MP2110A optical sampling oscilloscope, with an in-house designed O/E conversion module of 60 GHz optical bandwidth and sampler module of 80 GHz electrical bandwidth, for evaluating 100 GBaud (200Gbps/Lane) PAM4 signals in next-generation optical transceiver development and manufacturing; supports four-channel simultaneous measurement and faster measurement for production. The company states the Ethernet transition from 800GE to 1.6TE is accelerating
quarterly_data.figure: 60 GHz optical bandwidth; 80 GHz electrical bandwidth; 100 GBaud (200Gbps/Lane)

quarterly_data.signal: PCIe: the company launched a Base Test-capable measurement instrument for PCIe Gen7 and, with PCIe Optical Link standardization, is evaluating Gen6 optical links together with optical component vendors; for PCIe Gen6 it supported initial device evaluation for several component vendors before certification testing began

Other segments, fiscal year ended March 2026: PQA revenue JPY 31,033 million (up 9.9%) and operating profit JPY 3,318 million (up 17.0%), about half of PQA sales overseas; Environmental Measurement revenue JPY 10,787 million (up 26.2%) and operating profit JPY 850 million (down 5.5%) as domestic EV/battery test customers delayed investment amid US tariff policy and an EV investment adjustment. DEWETRON GmbH (power meters and data acquisition systems), acquired from TKH Group N.V. on October 21, 2025, has been consolidated since November
